opening.argument: The material presents itself as regional political reporting and analysis, centered on Assam and Mizoram and supported by official-looking government imagery, political figures, a regional map, and a headline concerning a lawsuit and travel advisory. A press-conference scene with officials and uniformed personnel, together with graphics identifying the Governments of Mizoram and Assam and the Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department, is consistent with reporting or commentary. The channel itself describes its videos as “News Editorial” and “for Informational purpose only,” while the closing graphic identifies international news, politics, and news analysis. Nothing described here offers money, requests payment or credentials, or sets out another mechanism for obtaining something from viewers.

citations.quote: Videos published here are mainly News Editorial and for Informational purpose only.
